design_description: A vibrant pink-and-white design built on the Fracture template, combining aggressive zebra-like striping with layered shattered textures across the entire jersey. The mix of cracked geometric fragments and paint-splatter details gives the shirt a chaotic, high-energy identity while still keeping a clean overall structure. White trims on the collar and sleeve cuffs help balance the loud palette and reinforce the sharp contrast of the fractured graphics. Overall, the design feels bold, youthful, and expressive — blending street-art aesthetics with an energetic modern football look.
